Head-to-Head Showdown

ASUS TUF Gaming A15 (FA507XV) vs ASUS Vivobook Pro 15 OLED (M6500QC)

Side-by-side spec analysis, real GPU wattage (TGP) comparison, display quality breakdown, and clear value verdict for Indian buyers.

🏆 Winner Recommendation: ASUS TUF Gaming A15 (FA507XV)

We recommend the ASUS TUF Gaming A15 (FA507XV) as the overall winner in this matchup due to its higher 140W GPU TGP (vs 50W), richer 100% sRGB color-accurate display, superior frame rates in AAA benchmarks. However, consider the ASUS Vivobook Pro 15 OLED (M6500QC) if you prefer its specific brand ecosystem or aesthetic design.
